evidence: Matches the 'Build system' label and updates cmake/introspection.cmake to detect and pass MSVC flags for hardware-accelerated SHA-256.
rationale: Enables hardware-accelerated SHA-256 compiler flags in CMake for MSVC builds, eliminating a significant hashing performance penalty on that platform. While sipsorcery reported a 5x to 10x speedup in benchmarks, official release binaries do not build with MSVC, making this worthwhile but reasonably deferrable.
